newsitem.title: USA: Affymetrix, OncorMed to develop cancer test.
newsitem.headline: Affymetrix, OncorMed to develop cancer test.

text.p: Affymetrix Inc said Monday that it and Maryland-based OncorMed Inc have signed an agreement to develop genetic testing services using Affymetrix's GeneChip system for analyzing genes associated with cancer.

The GeneChip system provides genetic analysis using miniaturized, high-density arrays of DNA probes, or "chips", and proprietary software, the company said. It is designed to help evaluate the aggressiveness of tumors and the appropriateness of therapies for breast, colon, ovarian and other cancers, Affymetrix said.
